target.title: test(gateway): isolate live-event sweep assertion
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The full gateway test shard can leave unrelated stale run contexts in the process-global registry. The worker live-event test asserted the registry-wide sweep count was exactly one, so it failed deterministically when other stale contexts existed.

## Why This Change Was Made

Assert the target run context exists before the sweep and is gone afterward. This preserves the test's real contract: sweeping the target context forces the receiver to resync, without coupling the assertion to unrelated global state.

## User Impact

None. Test-only stabilization; production behavior unchanged.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/worker-environments/live-events.test.ts` — 4 files, 100 tests passed
- `git diff --check`
- Original PR CI run 29235392005 reproduced the stale-count mismatch twice: expected 1, received 3
- Manual whole-path review: registry sweep, target lookup, receiver claim/resync, and adjacent tests
